Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

Chicken Parmesan 🧀🍗 Prep: 10m | Cook: 10m | Serves: 1-2 Ingredients: The Cutlet: 1 large chicken breast (butterflied & pounded even) Rub: 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp black pepper, salt to taste Breading:  1/4 cup flour | 2 beaten eggs | 1 cup Panko + 1 tsp dried parsley Oil for frying Sauce & Cheese: 1.5 cups marinara sauce 1 cup shredded mozzarella Method: 1. Pre-heat Oven to 350F. 2. Prep & Season: Butterfly chicken, pound even, and rub thoroughly with garlic powder, pepper, and salt. 3. Bread: Dredge in flour ➔ submerge in egg ➔ press firmly into parsley-Panko. 4. Fry: Cook in hot oil (or deep fry) for 3–4 mins per side until deep golden (165°F). Move to a wire rack. 5. Melt: Spread marinara on an oven-safe plate, cover with mozzarella, and bake until mozzarella cheese is melted. Broil for last 3-4 minutes until bubbly and browned. 6. Pour-Over: Drop cutlet onto the hot plate and slide the molten cheese and sauce over the top. Serve immediately! #asmr #recipe #cooking #foodtok

Cornflake Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🍗 Prep Time: 30 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Easy Pantry Ranch 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/3 cup buttermilk 1 tsp dried dill 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1 tsp white vinegar or lemon juice 1/4 tsp kosher salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Chicken and Marinade 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, patted dry 1 cup buttermilk 1 tbsp hot sauce 1 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 3-Step Breading Station 3/4 cup all-purpose flour + 1/2 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder 2 large eggs + 1 tbsp water, beaten 4 cups plain cornflakes, crushed into coarse crumbs 4-6 cups neutral frying oil Garlic Hot Honey Glaze 1/2 cup honey 2 tbsp fresh minced garlic 1-2 tbsp hot sauce 1 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tsp apple cider vinegar 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk together mayo, buttermilk, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cover and refrigerate while prepping the chicken. 2. Whisk buttermilk, hot sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Toss chicken tenders in marinade, cover, and chill for 30 minutes to 4 hours. 3. Set up three dishes: seasoned flour, beaten egg wash, and coarsely crushed cornflakes. 4. Drain excess marinade from each tender, dredge in flour, dip in egg wash, and press firmly into cornflakes. Rest on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes. 5. Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F. Fry tenders in batches of 3-4 for 4-6 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 6. Melt butter over low heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute. Stir in honey, hot sauce, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes, simmering gently for 2-3 minutes. 7. Drizzle warm garlic hot honey over crispy tenders and serve immediately with chilled ranch. #cooking #recipe #asmr #foodtok

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy Chicken Breast Nuggets with Spicy Cane’s-Style Sauce 🍗 I made these nuggets with ground chicken thighs last time and everyone hated that they looked gray inside 😂 So I’m making them again, this time with ground chicken breast and a spicy Cane’s-style sauce for dipping. Would you try this batch?  Recipe  Chicken mixture 1 lb ground chicken breast 1 large egg 2 tbsp cornstarch ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp white pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Wet batter ½ cup all-purpose flour ¼ cup cornstarch ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper ½ tsp paprika or chili powder ½ tsp garlic powder ½–¾ cup cold water Dry coating ½ cup all-purpose flour For frying Neutral oil, enough for about 1½ inches in the pot Spicy Cane’s-style sauce ½ cup mayonnaise 1–2 tbsp sriracha 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper How to make it Mix the ground chicken breast, egg, cornstarch, and seasonings until smooth and sticky. Lightly oil your hands and shape the mixture into small nuggets about ½ inch thick. Place them on a parchment-lined tray and freeze for a few hours, until frozen. Whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and seasonings for the wet batter. Start with ½ cup cold water and add more a little at a time until the batter coats the nuggets and the excess drips off easily. Put the flour for the dry coating in a separate bowl. Heat the oil to 350°F. Lightly coat each frozen nugget in flour, shake off the excess, then dip it into the wet batter. Let the extra batter drip off before frying. Fry in small batches, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy. Start checking around 4–5 minutes and cook until the centers reach 165°F. Drain on a wire rack and rest for 1–2 minutes. Mix the mayo, sriracha, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Start with 1 tablespoon of sriracha and add more to taste. Serve with the hot nuggets for dipping! #chickennuggets #homemadenuggets #crispychicken #easyrecipes #platedbyyuri

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Creamy Chicken Tostones 😍 This recipe is a 10/10, and I’m already thinking about making it again next week. 😋 Ingredients:  * 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces * ½ teaspoon each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano * Oil, for cooking the chicken and frying the plantains * 2 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks * ⅓ red bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ green bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ white onion, sliced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tablespoon butter * 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for topping * 1 tablespoon tomato paste * 1/2  chicken bouillon * 1½ cups heavy cream, or adjust to your preferred amount of sauce * ⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (add more if you want to) Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano. 2. Heat a little oil in a pan over high heat. Add the chicken and sear until browned and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. Raise the heat and fry the flattened plantains until crispy and golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt right away. 5. In a pan, heat a little oil and melt the butter. Add the peppers and onion and cook for about a minute. Add the garlic and cilantro and cook for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Stir in the tomato paste and chicken bouillon. Add the heavy cream and Parmesan, then stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy. 7. Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat. Taste and adjust the salt as needed. Finish with cilantro. 8. Spoon the creamy chicken over the tostones, or serve it on the side.
